en.headline: Hong Kong inventors take Grand Prix and 35 medals at Silicon Valley festival
en.dek: A solar-powered air-to-fertiliser system won the top prize; the Hong Kong delegation secured 22 gold and 13 silver medals at the event that ended on Sunday.
body: Hong Kong innovators won the Grand Prix, eight special awards and 35 medals at the Silicon Valley International Invention Festival, which concluded at the Santa Clara Convention Center in California on Sunday.

Amonova’s regenerative, solar-powered air-to-fertiliser production platform claimed the festival’s highest honour as well as a special prize from the China Association of Inventions. The system uses air, water and renewable energy to produce nitrogen fertiliser on site.
Founder Simson Wu said the technology effectively shrinks a large fertiliser plant into a machine that farmers can use directly. The city’s overall haul included 22 gold and 13 silver medals.

zh.headline: 港發明家矽谷發明節奪全場大獎及35獎
zh.dek: 太陽能空氣製肥系統奪最高榮譽；香港代表團合共取得22金13銀，活動周日於加州聖塔克拉拉結束。
body: 香港創新團隊在矽谷國際發明節奪得全場大獎、八個特別獎及35面獎牌，活動周日於加州聖塔克拉拉會議中心結束。
Amonova的再生太陽能空氣製肥平台奪得最高榮譽，並獲中國發明協會特別獎。該系統利用空氣、水及可再生能源在現地生產氮肥。
創辦人胡先生表示，技術將大型化肥廠縮小為農民可直接使用的機器。香港代表團合共取得22金及13銀。
